SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

File No............
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S.S.I.S. B. REGISTRY）
Date 22. 4. 32.
No. D 3516.

Subject (in full) Shing Li Company

Made by J.D.C.Fuchi Forwarded by J Knight O.D.I

Sir,
I beg to report that with reference to the attached reports re.
Shing Li Company, I visited the Military Police Headquarters at No.
1 Kiangnan Road, where I interviewed Major Hase, who stated that the
evacuation from the area under the jurisdiction of the Japanese Mili-
tary such as Lihuo, Hading, Nanxiang and etc, were not to be arranged
by the Military Police, therefore, he had never received any applica-
tion, but in case of any application being received in future, he
would communicate with Hongkew Station to make joint enquiries, as
it appeared that some Japanese civilians were concerned.
The permit for evacuation from such places as mentioned is at
present, as a rule, issued by the Japanese Consulate, the same must
be however countersigned at the Military Headquarters at 200 Ping-
liang Road, and if the area from where the property to be taken
away is under the jurisdiction of the Naval Landing Party, the per-
mit should be countersigned at the Landing Party Headquarters. Even
these passes often become void when Commander of Battalion or Sec-
tion stationed in the area is not agreeable.
I visited the Japanese Consulate where I interviewed Assistant
Magistrate Okamura, who stated that passes were being authorized to
persons who were believed to be trustworthy, but in future he would
make enquiries in case of any application being submitted with a
view to ascertaining whether the same was connected with Shing Li
Co. He also stated that there would be some reservists between the
Military Headquarters and Shing Li Co. and that they would be taking
advantage of their position. He warned Military Headquarters not
to entertain any application unless it has come through due formali-
ties.

（批注/签名区域）
Knight capt S.B. D

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

档案号............
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / S.S.I.S. B. 登记处）
日期 1932年4月22日。
编号 D 3516。

主题（全称）兴利公司（Shing Li Company）

呈报人 J.D.C.Fuchi 转呈人 J Knight O.D.I

先生，
谨此报告，关于所附有关兴利公司的报告，本人前往江南路1号宪兵司令部，会见了长谷川（Hase）少校。他表示，从日本军方管辖区域（如浏河、嘉定、南翔等）的撤离事宜并非由宪兵队安排，因此他从未收到任何申请。但若将来收到此类申请，鉴于似乎涉及部分日本平民，他将与虹口巡捕房联系进行联合调查。
目前，从上述地点撤离的许可证通常由日本领事馆签发，但必须在平凉路200号的日军司令部加签；如果财产搬离的区域属于海军陆战队管辖，则许可证应在海军陆战队司令部加签。即使持有这些通行证，如果驻扎在该区域的营长或连长不同意，通行证往往也会失效。
本人走访了日本领事馆，会见了副领事冈村（Okamura）。他表示，通行证仅签发给被认为可信的人员，但今后若有申请提交，他将进行调查，以核实是否与兴利公司有关。他还表示，日军司令部与兴利公司之间有一些预备役人员，他们正在利用其职位之便。他警告日军司令部，除非经过正当手续，否则不得受理任何申请。

（批注/签名区域）

Date April 16, 1932.

Subject (in full) Further Report re Shing Li Company.

Made by D. I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by Tho Robertson Supt

（批：3 opinions /）

Further enquiries at the Shing Li Co., 183
East Broadway, show that the promoters of this Company,
which came into existence on April 5 are Chih Tsz-lian
(季子連), alias Chi Hai-lai (季海瀾) who admitted being
proprietor of the Chih Shun Shing Bird Shop at this
address and one Wong Sin San (王山). According to
Chih Tsz-lien, any applicant who wishes to have goods
removed from the area occupied by the Japanese military
is required to fill in a form on the following lines:-
"I beg to state that I have a ............ shop at
.............. and would like have my effects removed
as I have already contracted to sell them. Please issue
a pass. Particulars are as follows:-
Applicant
Present Address
The place from where effects are to be removed.
The place to which effected are to be removed.
Description of Articles and quantity.
Name of Shop (Chopped).
Name of Applicant (Chopped)
Imperial Army of Great Japan".
He stated that this application would be forwarded
to the Japanese Military Headquarters where he could
arrange to have the necessary pass issued. He refused
to state the fee to be charged for the work but intimated
that this would be discussed after the application had
been properly filled in and chopped and handed to him.
It is learned that Chih Tsz-lien, native of
Chekiang, age about 30, was once a merchant in Japan and

主题（全称）关于兴利公司的进一步报告。

呈报人 D. I. Sih Tse-liang 转呈人 Tho Robertson 警司

（批注：3条意见 /）

对位于百老汇路183号的兴利公司进行的进一步调查显示，该公司于4月5日成立，发起人为季子连（Chih Tsz-lian），别名季海澜（Chi Hai-lai），他承认是该地址“季顺兴鸟店”的店主，另一发起人为王山（Wong Sin San）。据季子连称，任何希望将货物从日军占领区运出的申请人，需按以下格式填写表格：“本人声明，本人在..............拥有............商店，因已签订出售合同，欲将物品搬离。请签发通行证。详情如下：
申请人
现住址
物品搬离地点
物品搬往地点
物品描述及数量
商店名称（盖章）
申请人姓名（盖章）
大日本帝国陆军”。
他表示，此申请将转交至日本军方司令部，他可安排签发必要的通行证。他拒绝说明办理此项工作收取的费用，但暗示在申请表正确填写、盖章并交给他之后再进行商议。

can speak Japanese. According to the shop assistants Chi
has several acquaintances among the adjutants of the Japanese
Military Headquarters, and it is believed that he is relying
upon them for assistance in securing the pass. Chih, who is
an opium addict, is reported to be an opium smuggler dealing
with transportation of contraband from wharves, and his bird

Chih S Chieh (李世階), referred to in my former

Wong Sih San (王錫山), native of Soochow is Chih's

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch S. 1 STATION,
REPORT
Date April 14, 19 32.

Subject (in full) Shing Li Company

Made by D. I. Sih Tsz-liang Forwarded by H W Robertson Supt.

With reference to attached translation of advertisement
appearing in to-day's "Sin Wen Pao", a visit to the address
given revealed that this place is occupied by Chih Shun Shing
(老順興) Bird Shop. On the signboard of the shop, a red
poster inscribed "Shing Li" (興利) is pasted. Enquiries
show that the Shing Li concern is established in an upstairs
room and organized by one Wong Sih-san (王錫山) who was out
at the time of the visit. During the visit there were in the
shop five Chinese who expressed their willingness to convey
the particulars of any transactions to Wong.

This place is installed with a telephone No.52980
which is registered in the Chinese Telephone Book under the
name "Chi Hai-lai" (老海萊).

Enquiries by telephone show that the receiver is
one who calls himself Chi S-chieh (李世傑) and who admitted
that he was speaking from "Shing Li" and was responsible for
the advertisement. On being asked about the procedure in
removing goods, Chi said that he preferred a personal
interview adding that he could send someone along to the
applicant's address if desired. In conclusion he explained
that he could secure passes from the Japanese and guarantee
the safe transportation and delivery of the desired articles
to any place agreed upon, but refused to state the fee to
be charged for the work.

Sih Tse Liang
D. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch

All further enquiries are being made
H.R.
- J.C. (Brine) Information and forms of forwarding to
Commissioner of Police.
J. Simons
O. i/c Sp. Br.

特别分部 S. 1 巡捕房，
报告
日期 1932年4月14日。

主题（全称）兴利公司

呈报人 D. I. Sih Tsz-liang 转呈人 H W Robertson 警司。

鉴于今日《新闻报》（Sin Wen Pao）上刊登的广告译文，本人前往广告所示地址查看，发现该处为“老顺兴”（Chih Shun Shing）鸟店。店招上贴有一张写有“兴利”（Shing Li）字样的红色海报。调查显示，兴利商号设在一间楼上房间内，由王锡山（Wong Sih-san）组织成立，走访时他不在店内。走访期间，店内有五名华人，他们表示愿意向王某转达任何交易的详情。

该处安装有一部电话，号码为52980，在中文电话簿中以“老海莱”（Chi Hai-lai）之名注册。

通过电话查询得知，接听者自称李世杰（Chi S-chieh），他承认是从“兴利”公司通话，并负责该广告。当被问及搬运货物的程序时，李某表示更倾向于面谈，并补充说如有需要，他可以派人前往申请人地址。最后他解释说，他能从日本人那里获得通行证，并保证将所需物品安全运输并交付到任何约定的地点，但拒绝说明办理此项工作收取的费用。

Sih Tse Liang
侦探督察（D. I.）
特别分部主管警官

正在进行所有进一步调查
H.R.
- J.C. (Brine) 情报及转呈警察总监的表格。
J. Simons
特别分部主管警官
